item.title: Building a RAG Text-to-SQL Agent: Natural Language Database Queries with Ollama and ChromaDB
item.description: A comprehensive guide to building a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system that converts natural language questions into SQL queries using Ollama 3.2, ChromaDB, and LangChain.
